data.one_liner: A complete frontend architecture framework for building Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Stacked provides a full architectural framework for Flutter applications, handling state management, dependency injection, and navigation. It utilizes ViewModels to separate UI from business logic to keep apps testable and scalable.
use_when: You want a complete out-of-the-box architecture for production apps
You prefer MVVM pattern with ViewModels and services
You need structured navigation, dependency injection, and state management combined
avoid_when: You prefer a minimal, unopinionated state management solution
You use Riverpod or BLoC and want to stick to those paradigms
strengths: Provides a complete architectural standard out of the box
Built-in support for dependency injection and routing
Makes testing business logic via ViewModels straightforward
weaknesses: Opinionated framework that locks you into its specific structure
Steeper learning curve for developers used to simpler state holders
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up the recommended folder structure and registering services with the built-in dependency injection container.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a strict predictable state management pattern based on events and states.

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a compile-safe, provider-based dependency and state management approach.

alternatives.name: get
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want lightweight routing, dependency injection, and state management without a rigid architecture.
